source: Showdown f76228a1 (the CI runtime build), gen3customgame: p1 Arbok (Wrap, Splash) Wraps p2 Snorlax (Splash; Blissey on the bench) until it hits, then both Splash until |-end|p2a: Snorlax|Wrap|[partiallytrapped]; 4,000 battles, each seeded with four 16-bit words of a fixed integer hash of its index (structured seeds such as [i+1, 7i+3, 13i+5, 101+i] correlate the duration roll with the accuracy roll before it and skew this table by up to 11%). durations[D] = how often the trap held D residuals (from its -activate line to its -end line, the ending residual included); remaining_after_k_ticks[k][r] = how often the duration still held after k [partiallytrapped] ticks was r = D - k; ticks_equal_duration_minus_one = battles with exactly D - 1 ticks; holder_request_trapped = battles whose holder request showed trapped; sample_lines = the start, a tick and the end; trapper_leaves = 200 battles where Arbok switches out after the hit: the next residual's line. Script: reports trap-walls-20261115/wrap_sim.js.
